```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(learnr)
library(fpp3)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4
)
source("lab_submission.R")

lab_meta <- list(id = "lab03", title = "ARMA")
lab_prompts <- c(
  q1 = "For MA(1) with theta = 0.5, rho_1 equals:",
  q2 = "PACF cuts off after lag p and ACF tails off. The process is:",
  q3 = "AR(1) is stationary when:",
  q4 = "After you simulate or plot lynx, what order would you try first, and why?"
)
```

## What you will do

Compute an MA(1) autocorrelation and match ACF/PACF patterns to AR vs MA.

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `fpp3`, `learnr`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.


```{r ma-rho, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=4}
theta <- 0.5
theta / (1 + theta^2)
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("0.4", correct = TRUE),
  answer("0.5"),
  answer("0.25"),
  answer("0"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```
```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("AR(p)", correct = TRUE),
  answer("MA(p)"),
  answer("White noise"),
  answer("Random walk"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```
```{r q3}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  answer("|phi| < 1", correct = TRUE),
  answer("|phi| > 1"),
  answer("Always, for any phi"),
  answer("Only if theta < 1"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```
```{r q4}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q4"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "e.g. PACF cutoff suggests AR(2) or AR(3); annual, no season.",
  trim = TRUE
)
```

```{r submit-ui, echo=FALSE}
shiny::textInput("student_name", "Your name", placeholder = "Name Surname")

```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {
    write_lab_submission(
      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = learnr::get_tutorial_state(),
      prompts = lab_prompts
    )
  }
)
```
